lead: Rishi Kapoor was an Indian actor, born on 4 September 1952 in Mumbai.
He died on 30 April 2020 in Mumbai at the age of 67.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Filmfare Awards.

sections.heading: Rishi Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rishi Kapoor was born on 4 September 1952 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Raj Kapoor and his mother, Krishna Kapoor. He is a sibling of Ritu Nanda, Randhir Kapoor, Rajiv Kapoor and Rima Jain.
He studied at Campion School, Mumbai and Colonel Brown Cambridge School.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.
